children: A weapon with a Double Trigger treats one trigger as a "safety," with the second trigger being a hair trigger that fires when the slightest pressure is applied to it. Weapons of this type can be extremely accurate, since only a small amount of pressure is needed to fire them (reducing the chance of moving the weapon slightly while pulling the trigger), but this takes time and training.
